timecodes.what: At kf_004.jpg (16.5s) (widescreen camera frame), BrainFacts.org's recording states "He's trying to rewire areas in his brain so it can turn shapes of letters on paper into sounds and words of spoken language." — providing spoken context for 2006 Paris NeuroSpin Lab: Dialing a 50-ms Mask Past the Tipping Point Triggers 300-ms Frontoparietal 'Global Ignition'.

Mid-segment widescreen camera frame at kf_009.jpg (44.0s) as narration explains "He won the brain prize in 2014. He studies how reading takes place in the brain. He is a professor at Kalej de France", clarifying key empirical findings in Stanislas Dehaene, Jean-Pierre Changeux & Lionel Naccache's 2006 NeuroSpin / Collège de France 'Global Neuronal Workspace' Consciousness Experiments.

Around kf_010.jpg (49.5s) (widescreen camera frame), commentary states "He is a professor at Kalej de France and the leader of Insurm CE.", connecting the empirical results to broader cognitive and neural science.
